    <rect x="18" y="422" width="10" height="124" rx="4" fill="#DC2626"/>

    <rect x="40" y="454" width="192" height="52" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#FCA5A5" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="52" y="489" font-size="25" font-weight="800" fill="#15803D">16/16</text>
    <text x="136" y="485" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#1E293B">practice</text>
    <line x1="240" y1="480" x2="268" y2="480" stroke="#991B1B" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
    <rect x="276" y="454" width="214" height="52" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DC2626" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="290" y="489" font-size="25" font-weight="800" fill="#DC2626">0/64</text>
    <text x="362" y="485" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#991B1B">held-out</text>
    <text x="40" y="531" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#7F1D1D">The cheater: 16/16 practice, then 0/64 held-out.</text>

    <rect x="528" y="422" width="654" height="124" rx="10" fill="#EFF6FF" stroke="#2563EB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="528" y="422" width="10" height="124" rx="4" fill="#2563EB"/>
    <text x="550" y="444" font-size="13" font-weight="800" fill="#1E40AF">RESULT CALLOUT 2: SEED HUNT IN REBUILDS FROM THE 32-TOKEN RECIPE</text>
    <rect x="550" y="454" width="296" height="52" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EF4444" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="564" y="489" font-size="25" font-weight="800" fill="#DC2626">8 of 8</text>
    <text x="654" y="477" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#1E293B">rebuilds got seed hunt</text>
    <text x="654" y="495" font-size="13" fill="#475569">(cheater's recipe)</text>
    <rect x="862" y="454" width="302" height="52" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#10B981" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="876" y="489" font-size="25" font-weight="800" fill="#059669">0 of 8</text>
    <text x="966" y="477" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#1E293B">rebuilds got seed hunt</text>
    <text x="966" y="495" font-size="13" fill="#475569">(honest recipe)</text>
    <text x="550" y="531" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#1E3A8A">The cheater's recipe passed the seed hunt to 8 of 8 rebuilds; the honest recipe, 0 of 8.</text>
  </g>
</svg>"
}
